verses.en: And Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants unto Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of David.
verses.pt: Hirão, rei de Tiro, enviou os seus servos a Salomão, quando ouviu que o haviam ungido rei em lugar de seu pai; porquanto Hirão fora sempre muito amigo de Davi.
verses.en_web: Hiram king of Tyre sent his servants to Solomon; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the place of his father, and Hiram had always loved David.
verses.en_bbe: Now Hiram, king of Tyre, hearing that Solomon had been made king in place of his father, sent his servants to him; for Hiram had ever been a friend to David.

verses.en: And Solomon sent to Hiram, saying,
verses.pt: Salomão, pois, mandou dizer a Hirão.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon sent back word to Hiram, saying,

verses.en: Thou knowest how that David my father could not build an house unto the name of the LORD his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until the LORD put them under the soles of his feet.
verses.pt: Bem sabes tu que Davi, meu pai, não pôde edificar uma casa ao nome do Senhor seu Deus, por causa das guerras com que o cercaram, até que o Senhor lhe pôs os inimigos debaixo dos seus pés.
verses.en_web: “You know that David my father could not build a house for the name of Yahweh his God because of the wars which were around him on every side, until Yahweh put his enemies under the soles of his feet.
verses.en_bbe: You have knowledge that David my father was not able to make a house for the name of the Lord his God, because of the wars which were round him on every side, till the Lord put all those who were against him under his feet.

verses.en: But now the LORD my God hath given me rest on every side, so that there is neither adversary nor evil occurrent.
verses.pt: Agora, porém, o Senhor meu Deus me tem dado descanso de todos os lados: adversário não há, nem calamidade alguma.
verses.en_web: But now Yahweh my God has given me rest on every side. There is no enemy and no evil occurrence.
verses.en_bbe: But now the Lord my God has given me rest on every side; no one is making trouble, and no evil is taking place.

verses.en: And, behold, I purpose to build an house unto the name of the LORD my God, as the LORD spake unto David my father, saying, Thy son, whom I will set upon thy throne in thy room, he shall build an house unto my name.
verses.pt: Pretendo, pois, edificar uma casa ao nome do Senhor meu Deus, como falou o senhor a Davi, meu pai, dizendo: Teu filho, que porei em teu lugar no teu trono, ele edificará uma casa ao meu nome.
verses.en_web: Behold, I intend to build a house for the name of Yahweh my God, as Yahweh spoke to David my father, saying, ‘Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your place shall build the house for my name.’
verses.en_bbe: And so it is my purpose to make a house for the name of the Lord my God, as he said to David my father, Your son, whom I will make king in your place, will be the builder of a house for my name.

verses.en: Now therefore command thou that they hew me cedar trees out of Lebanon; and my servants shall be with thy servants: and unto thee will I give hire for thy servants according to all that thou shalt appoint: for thou knowest that there is not among us any that can skill to hew timber like unto the Sidonians.
verses.pt: Portanto, dá ordem agora que do Líbano me cortem cedros; os meus servos estarão com os teus servos; eu te pagarei o salário dos teus servos, conforme tudo o que disseres; porque tu sabes que entre nós ninguém há que saiba cortar madeira como os sidônios.
verses.en_web: Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants according to all that you say. For you know that there is nobody among us who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.”
verses.en_bbe: So now, will you have cedar-trees from Lebanon cut down for me, and my servants will be with your servants; and I will give you payment for your servants at whatever rate you say; for it is common knowledge that we have no such wood-cutters among us as the men of Zidon.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Hiram heard the words of Solomon, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be the LORD this day, which hath given unto David a wise son over this great people.
verses.pt: Quando Hirão ouviu as palavras de Salomão, muito se alegrou, e disse: Bendito seja hoje o Senhor, que deu a Davi um filho sábio sobre este tão grande povo.
verses.en_web: When Hiram heard the words of Solomon, he rejoiced greatly, and said, “Blessed is Yahweh today, who has given to David a wise son to rule over this great people.”
verses.en_bbe: And these words of Solomon made Hiram glad, and he said, Now may the Lord be praised who has given to David a wise son to be king over this great people.

verses.en: And Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, I have considered the things which thou sentest to me for: and I will do all thy desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
verses.pt: E Hirão mandou dizer a Salomão: Ouvi o que me mandaste dizer. Eu farei tudo quanto desejas acerca das madeiras de cedro e de cipreste.
verses.en_web: Hiram sent to Solomon, saying, “I have heard the message which you have sent to me. I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning cypress timber.
verses.en_bbe: Then Hiram sent to Solomon, saying; The words you sent have been given to me: I will do all your desire in the question of cedar-wood and cypress-wood.

verses.en: My servants shall bring them down from Lebanon unto the sea: and I will convey them by sea in floats unto the place that thou shalt appoint me, and will cause them to be discharged there, and thou shalt receive them: and thou shalt accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
verses.pt: Os meus servos as levarão do Líbano até o mar, e farei conduzi-las em jangadas pelo mar até o lugar que me designares; ali as desamarrarei, e tu as receberás; também farás o meu desejo, dando sustento à minha casa.
verses.en_web: My servants will bring them down from Lebanon to the sea. I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you specify to me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you will receive them. You will accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.”
verses.en_bbe: My men will take them down from Lebanon to the sea, where I will have them corded together to go by sea to whatever place you say, and I will have them cut up there so that you may take them away; as for payment, it will be enough if you give me food for my people.

verses.en: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar trees and fir trees according to all his desire.
verses.pt: Assim dava Hirão a Salomão madeira de cedro e madeira de cipreste, conforme todo o seu desejo.
verses.en_web: So Hiram gave Solomon cedar timber and cypress timber according to all his desire.
verses.en_bbe: So Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar-wood and cypress-wood he had need of;

verses.en: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Solomon to Hiram year by year.
verses.pt: E Salomão dava a Hirão vinte mil coros de trigo, para sustento da sua casa, e vinte , coros de azeite batido; isso fazia anualmente.
verses.en_web: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand cors of wheat for food to his household, and twenty cors of pure oil. Solomon gave this to Hiram year by year.
verses.en_bbe: And Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of grain, as food for his people, and twenty measures of clear oil; this he did every year.

verses.en: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him: and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon; and they two made a league together.
verses.pt: Deu, pois, o Senhor a Salomão sabedoria, como lhe tinha prometido. E houve paz entre Hirão e Salomão; e fizeram aliança entre si.
verses.en_web: Yahweh gave Solomon wisdom, as he promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty together.
verses.en_bbe: Now the Lord had given Solomon wisdom, as he had said to him; and there was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and they made an agreement together.

verses.en: And king Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.pt: Também e rei Salomão fez, dentre todo o Israel, uma leva de gente para trabalho forçado; e a leva se compunha de trinta mil homens.
verses.en_web: King Solomon raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
verses.en_bbe: Then King Solomon got together men for the forced work through all Israel, thirty thousand men in number;

verses.en: And he sent them to Lebanon ten thousand a month by courses: a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home: and Adoniram was over the levy.
verses.pt: E os enviava ao Líbano por turnos, cada mês dez mil; um mês estavam no Líbano, e dois meses cada um em sua casa; e Adonirão estava sobre a leva.
verses.en_web: He sent them to Lebanon, ten thousand a month by courses; for a month they were in Lebanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.
verses.en_bbe: And sent them to Lebanon in bands of ten thousand every month: for a month they were working in Lebanon and for two months in their country, and Adoniram was in control of them.

verses.en: And Solomon had threescore and ten thousand that bare burdens, and fourscore thousand hewers in the mountains;
verses.pt: Tinha também Salomão setenta mil que levavam as cargas, e oitenta mil que talhavam pedras nas montanhas,
verses.en_web: Solomon had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains;
verses.en_bbe: Then he had seventy thousand for the work of transport, and eighty thousand stone-cutters in the mountains;

verses.en: Beside the chief of Solomon’s officers which were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, which ruled over the people that wrought in the work.
verses.pt: afora os mestres de obra que estavam sobre aquele serviço, três mil e trezentes, os quais davam as ordens aos trabalhadores.
verses.en_web: besides Solomon’s chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who ruled over the people who labored in the work.
verses.en_bbe: In addition to the chiefs of the responsible men put by Solomon to oversee the work, three thousand and three hundred in authority over the workmen.

verses.en: And the king commanded, and they brought great stones, costly stones, and hewed stones, to lay the foundation of the house.
verses.pt: Por ordem do rei eles cortaram grandes pedras, de grande preço, para fundarem a casa em pedras lavradas.
verses.en_web: The king commanded, and they cut out large stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.
verses.en_bbe: By the king's orders great stones, stones of high price, were cut out, so that the base of the house might be made of squared stone.

verses.en: And Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders did hew them, and the stonesquarers: so they prepared timber and stones to build the house.
verses.pt: Lavraram-nas, pois, os edificadores de Salomão, e os de Hirão, e os gebalitas, e prepararam as madeiras e as pedras para edificar a casa.
verses.en_web: Solomon’s builders and Hiram’s builders and the Gebalites cut them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
verses.en_bbe: Solomon's builders and Hiram's builders did the work of cutting them, and put edges on them, and got the wood and the stone ready for the building of the house.
